checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1, the same page as the start of the itemized prices, so placement counts as correct.
The basic services item is priced at $2,195 but has no includesText, so the condition for reviewing the adequacy of the list is not met.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead charge, with no other mandatory facilities or staff fee.
D-embalming and the $795 Embalming price are both on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the price.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
No D-alt-container disclosure is printed on the list, so the placement condition is not met.
Direct cremation is offered with options including a purchaser-provided container, and no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions transportation to crematory and cremation but lists no separate crematory cash advance, so no double-billing is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation, and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered goods or services lack a price.
The list contains only required itemized offerings like forwarding, receiving, direct cremation, and immediate burial, with no optional package combinations.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase; the only law language is the required not-required statements.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown printed in a way that is hard to notice.
